text:
mina: Hey all, first-day hiccup. Ran the repo's `./dev up` and Postgres container starts but my app immediately errors `could not connect to server: No such file or directory` pointing at `/var/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432`. I'm on an M2 Mac. Any obvious things to check?

carlos: Welcome! That usually means your client is trying a unix socket on the host instead of TCP to the container. Do `env | grep -i database` and `echo $PGHOST` to see if you have old env vars.

mina: I do have `PGHOST` unset but `DATABASE_URL` in my shell is `postgres:///redwood`. Didn't realize that tries sockets.

sam: yup. `postgres:///redwood` omits host so libpq falls back to socket. For compose dev switch to explicit TCP: `postgresql://postgres:devpass@postgres:5432/redwood` or set `DB_HOST=postgres` in `.env.local`.

mina: changed to `postgresql://postgres:devpass@postgres:5432/redwood` and web connected. Two follow-ups: 1) my `docker-compose.yml` was mounting `./pgdata:/var/run/postgresql` (wtf from an old sample)  should I change that? 2) I had the port mapped `5432:5432` and a host Postgres app, any tips for avoiding collisions?

carlos: definitely don't mount into `/var/run/postgresql`  that folder is for sockets and container expects to control it. Use `/var/lib/postgresql/data` or a named volume. For host conflicts map to a different host port like `5433:5432` or stop the host Postgres while working on the repo.

devex-bot: Note: dev README recommends named volumes and setting `DB_HOST=postgres`. There's a short blurb about macOS filesystem mappings and permission issues.

sam: small pro-tip: if you want host psql access, map `5433:5432` and then `psql -h localhost -p 5433 -U postgres`. Also when creating host bind directories on mac, chown to the container UID to avoid permission errors: `mkdir pgdata && sudo chown -R 999:999 pgdata` then mount `./pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data`.

mina: thanks! I'll update my compose and open a tiny onboarding issue describing the socket vs TCP gotcha and the bad example that mounts into `/var/run/postgresql`. Filing now and linking this thread. Appreciate the help :smile:
